description: Figure 15 presents the Token Ratio (TR) for several datasets. The horizontal axis displays the dataset names: KoBEST, C4, PubMed, Wikipedia, and Books3, listed in that order. The vertical axis, labeled “Token Ratio,” represents a linear scale ranging from 0 to 1, with tick marks at 0.2 intervals.  There is a single bar for each dataset, colored in a shade of blue. The bar corresponding to Books3 is the tallest, reaching approximately 0.94. The bar for C4 is the shortest, with a height of approximately 0.57. The remaining bars have heights of approximately 0.78 for KoBEST, 0.73 for PubMed, and 0.68 for Wikipedia. The bars are arranged in the order of the dataset names listed on the horizontal axis and are not visually emphasized with shading, bolding, outlining, or annotations.
